story_title: Lina and Adams and the First Snow
title: Lina and Adams and the First Snow ❄️ | Learn Winter Words in English for Kids | Moon Tales Kids
description:
It's snowing! Play in the first snow of winter with Lina, Adams and Milo! ❄️⛄🧣
In this English story for kids, children learn 8 new words: snow, cold, coat, scarf, gloves, snowman, warm and soup. Listen, repeat, and learn English with Lina, Adams and Milo the cat.

📚 New words in this story:
❄️ snow — الثلج — la neige
🥶 cold — بارد — froid
🧥 coat — المعطف — le manteau
🧣 scarf — الوشاح — l'écharpe
🧤 gloves — القفازات — les gants
⛄ snowman — رجل الثلج — le bonhomme de neige
🤗 warm — دافئ — chaud / au chaud
🍲 soup — الحساء — la soupe

👨‍👩‍👧 For parents: play the story, pause after each new word, and ask your child to say it out loud. Perfect for ages 3 to 8 and for children learning English as a second language.

🇲🇦 قصص باللغة الإنجليزية للأطفال لتعلم كلمات جديدة بطريقة ممتعة.

lines.text: One winter morning, Lina looks out of the window.
Adams! Wake up! Everything is white!
Wow! It is snowing! Our first snow!
Milo puts his nose on the window. Meow?
Snow is soft, white, and cold. It falls from the sky in winter.
Say it with me: snow!
Adams opens the door and steps outside. Brrr!
Brrr! It is so cold! My nose is cold!
Come back in, Adams. We need warm clothes first.
When something is not warm at all, we say it is cold.
Say it with me: cold!
Can you shiver like Adams? Brrr!
First, we put on our coats.
My coat is big and puffy. It is blue like my shirt!
My coat is purple. Zip, zip!
A coat is a big jacket we wear over our clothes when it is cold.
Say it with me: coat!
Next, Lina finds a long, soft scarf.
I wrap the scarf around my neck. Round and round.
Can I have a scarf too?
Here, Adams. This one has stripes!
A scarf is a long piece of cloth that keeps our neck warm.
Say it with me: scarf!
Oh! My hands are still cold.
Here are your gloves, Adams. One for each hand.
Adams puts in one finger, two fingers, three, four, five!
Gloves cover our hands and fingers to keep them warm.
Say it with me: gloves!
Now I have my coat, my scarf, my hat, and my gloves. Let's go!
Lina and Adams run to the park. Crunch, crunch, go their boots.
Let's make a snowman!
They roll a big snowball, then a middle snowball, then a small one on top.
I will give him a carrot nose and a hat!
A snowman is a friend made of snow.
Say it with me: snowman!
Near the snowman, a little girl is standing alone.
She has no scarf. She looks very cold.
Hello! Are you cold? You can have my scarf.
Lina gently wraps her scarf around the little girl.
Do you want to play with us? We can make a snow family!
The little girl smiles. Now they have a new friend!
The sun goes down, and the air is colder now.
Let's go home and get warm!
Inside the house, they take off their coats and gloves.
Ahh, it is nice and warm here.
When we are not cold, and we feel cozy, we are warm.
Say it with me: warm!
Dinner is ready. There is a big bowl on the table.
Mmm, carrot soup! It smells so good.
Blow on it first. It is hot! Whoo, whoo.
Soup is a hot food we eat with a spoon.
Say it with me: soup!
Milo has warm milk. He purrs. Purr, purr.
Outside, the snow is still falling softly.
Today we saw snow. It was cold, but we had coats, scarves and gloves!
We built a snowman, and we made a new friend.
Lina and Adams snuggle in their warm beds.
Good night, snowman. Good night, Milo.
Good night, everyone!
